title: The Indigo Giant

presentation.description: REDACTED: a dying desert world its makers erased from every chart. The first record of Nyx, the Indigo Giant, and Orbit, who never left its side - and of Crimson, who stayed behind.

lore: An archive of the past that Gleebs carried into HoloVerse. After REDACTED, Nyx became the Hills of Life guide in GREEN HILLS and Orbit the HoloSpace flight guide.
